The independence ledger over a set of lenses

Source: R/independence.R
quorum_independence.Rd

Counts what every pair of lenses shares and converts it into the evidential weight the quorum rule reads. Two lenses declare four components – sampler, objective, priors and data_prep – and the weight for a pair is 1 - shared / 4, so a pair sharing nothing carries full weight, a pair sharing all four carries none, and a pair sharing one component carries three quarters.

Usage

quorum_independence(lenses, data_independence = NA)

Arguments

lenses

A list of quorum_lens() objects. An empty list is allowed and yields empty matrices; anything in the list that is not a lens is a programmer error.

data_independence

Single logical. TRUE when the lenses were fitted to independently-collected data, FALSE when they share one dataset, and NA (the default) when the caller has not established which. Anything other than TRUE attaches the caveat.

Value

A list of class quorum_independence with components (the four component names), shared (an integer matrix of the number of components each pair holds in common, NA on the diagonal), weight (the numeric matrix 1 - shared / 4, NA on the diagonal, rows and columns named for the lenses), data_independence as supplied, and caveat (the sentence to carry alongside the weights, or "").

Details

The declarations are the lenses' own. The ledger does not inspect an engine to discover what it shares with another, because the point of the declaration is that a member states its own dependencies where a reader can see and dispute them.

Data independence is a separate question the declarations cannot answer, so the caller supplies it. Left at NA – or set to FALSE – the result carries a caveat saying what agreement between lenses on one dataset does and does not establish. The caveat is empty only when the caller has positively established that the lenses saw independently-collected data.

See also

quorum_lens() for the declarations the ledger reads.

Examples

d <- quorum_draws(list(beta = rnorm(20L)))
mk <- function(nm, shares) {
  lens_from_draws(d, name = nm, member = "quorum", shares = shares)
}
a <- mk("a", c(sampler = "nuts", objective = "brms", priors = "hub",
               data_prep = "hub"))
b <- mk("b", c(sampler = "ies", objective = "simulator",
               priors = "ensemble", data_prep = "pesto"))
quorum_independence(list(a, b))
#> <quorum independence ledger>
#>   components: sampler, objective, priors, data_prep
#>   evidential weight (1 = shares nothing, 0 = shares everything)
#>    a  b
#> a NA  1
#> b  1 NA
#>   data independence: NA
#>   Agreement between lenses fitted to the same data is agreement, not corroboration of a shared data fact.
